title: Credits refunds and payment races
rule: Credit events are immutable integer USD cents with bonus spent before paid, no expiry and no negative balance. A reset consumes 500 cents, requires a unique current limit-hit id and has an idempotent atomic receipt. At most three enabled automatic resets per natural week. Trusted ledger fixture grants are the only credit source in P07. P08 must require a minimum 1000-cent verified payment, one open payment per owner, idempotent settlement, paid wins cancel races, nonnegative chargeback floor and no bonus refund. Refund agent usage once only for a platform-caused failure linked to its original debit; user errors are not refundable.
alternatives: Leave this decision deferred and block dependent implementation.
